description: ADMIN ONLY. Start here to create original VFX beyond presets. Returns the editable source format, shader helpers, geometry budgets and a working example. Workflow: write custom source -> render -> inspect the returned image -> revise -> save. Blender or another modeling tool may supply custom mesh vertices/UVs/indices; no Blender instance is required for procedural effects.

workspace_id.description: Explicit workspace id. The key must have access to this workspace; never infer another user’s workspace.

title: VFX authoring language and example
